QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Superior Arrows
QuestInfo.0: Anne, in #bMutant Tiru Forest#k, still needs more help. Go and talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Anne is running out of arrows. Get her #b40 Mutant Tiru Feathers#k to craft arrows with.
QuestInfo.2: You collected the feathers needed to make Superior Arrows.

0.0: All these fights with monsters and Knights is draining my arrow supplies. I don't have time to scout and get the materials to make more. Could you gather them for me?

yes.0: I know you can do it. And remember, I need #bMutant Tiru Feathers#k--#b40#k of them.

no.0: I guess you're busy right now. See if you can help me next time.

yes.0: Thanks a lot. So far I haven't even been able to stand up to the Chief Knight, but once I craft these arrows, maybe I could even take on Cygnus.

item.0: Come on! I need #b40 Mutant Tiru Feathers#k.
